title: Bottled Experience
description: Experience storage made easy with experience bottles!
body:
![banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6fb0c91bb6108056a94bf24ee99493db4cc9a901.jpeg)

**Bottled Experience**


Store your XP in a bottle before you die. Right-click with a Glass Bottle to bottle your experience, right-click with an Experience Bottle to get it back.

---

## Features
- Converts your XP into a bottled item with a single right-click
- Retrieving a bottle adds XP on top of your current levels
- Configurable max level cap per bottle
- Custom item name & lore with `%exp%` and `%levels%` placeholders
- XP stored via NBT — not parsed from lore text

## Configuration
```yaml
bottle:
  type: EXPERIENCE_BOTTLE
  max-levels: 30
  name: "&bBottle of Experience"
  lore:
    - "&7Levels: &b%levels%"
    - "&7Exp: &b%exp%"
```
